people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
translations.bsb: Moab is put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
translations.kjv: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
translations.asv: Moab is put to shame; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell ye it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
